signal: Prove launched its unified Identity Platform on April 22, 2026, positioning identity as the trust layer for people, businesses, and AI agents, building on its Verified Agent solution.

email.body1:
Mike, saw Prove launched the unified Identity Platform in April, positioning identity as the trust layer for people, businesses, and AI agents.

A launch that broad usually opens more accounts than your team can work before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Prove.

As the Identity Platform opens the agentic-trust segment, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to convert it, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other identity and fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while the Identity Platform rolls out, no problem at all. A platform launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an identity software motion? I will tailor it to Prove either way.
